verdict.rationale: Numeral's API is clearly versioned (e.g. v2026-03-01 paths) and ships a changelog documenting new features like IP-based tax resolution, showing some version lifecycle management. However, there is no evidence of a documented deprecation policy — no sunset timelines, backward-compatibility guarantees, or migration windows are mentioned anywhere in the docs. Missing for 10: explicit deprecation/sunset policy documentation, version support lifecycle, migration guides between versions, and independent confirmation of long-term API stability commitments.
